title: Pilih arah yang lebih berani
question: Putaran ini memakai bentuk asing untuk kategori belajar coding. Kartu pertama adalah hasil undian utama; alternatif tetap dapat dipilih. Pilih Build this untuk mengunci.

options.label: Syntax Field / Data Sublime
options.lineage: Ryoji Ikeda’s data-driven barcode and sine-lattice installations
options.thesis: Baca struktur belajar sebagai medan kode: tiap kolom menyimpan satu langkah, dan perubahan kecil langsung memindahkan pola yang terlihat.
options.viewport: A black-and-white course field fills the home screen. Four labeled course bands sit as a measured barcode matrix; one HTML column is sampled and expands into a readable Pengenalan HTML lesson, example code and plain browser preview. A stable “Mulai dari HTML” action remains clearly visible. No inversion flash is required to understand state.
options.risk: Data density can overwhelm a beginner; real Indonesian headings and explanations must stay readable while the barcode field remains a supporting visual structure.

options.label: Centre-Rail Study Edition
options.lineage: Wide-margin reference editions set with a ruling-engine centre rail
options.thesis: Keep lessons calm and legible while one precise centre rail carries course navigation, exercise actions and active reading marks.
options.viewport: A quiet two-column lesson fills the center at a narrow readable measure, flanked by generous annotation margins. One fine red center rail holds the active course key; HTML explanation and exact sample code align around it. An outer margin carries the course contents and a small, useful note linked to the active paragraph.
options.case: Learners already recognize reference books and ordered lesson notes; the rail makes the course map and current task unusually clear without inventing a new capability.
options.risk: Small type and narrow measures can slow scanning; preserve comfortable reading sizes and let margins absorb responsive width.

options.label: One-Step Lesson Feed
options.lineage: Full-viewport vertical snap feeds, adapted to text and code lessons
options.thesis: Give each learning step the whole screen and make the next step a single clear move away.
options.viewport: One concept occupies a full viewport: the HTML lesson title and an explanation lead, with its editor/preview pair below and one right rail for real actions such as previous, next and playground. A compact bottom caption names the current lesson. Vertical snap goes only between complete lesson steps; no video or social activity is implied.
options.case: The one-item-at-a-time rhythm helps isolate a concept; the familiar vertical gesture is retained while media and engagement assumptions are removed.
options.risk: Can hide course context and make long-form explanations feel fragmented.

options.label: Warm Pocket Academy
options.lineage: Warm consumer-app surfaces with thumb-reachable bottom navigation
options.thesis: Make the next learning action comfortable to reach and easy to understand on a small screen.
options.viewport: A one-column home shows “Pilih kursus”, the four available subjects, two beginner exercises and a persistent bottom bar for Belajar, Latihan, Playground and AI Tutor. The one saturated accent appears only on an action that works. The layout grows into a measured two-column SaaS workspace at desktop sizes.
options.case: Plain labels and reachable controls fit the self-directed beginner, though its card stack is less task-dense than the leader.
options.risk: Soft panels can become a generic list unless each retains one clear job and visible course order.

options.label: J-Card Course Index
options.lineage: Hand-lettered cassette J-cards, their spine, fold and ruled track lists
options.thesis: Treat a course as a compact sequence: its spine names the subject, and its unfolded sheet makes every lesson easy to scan.
options.viewport: A thin course spine labeled HTML opens into two visible surfaces: a short explanation on Side A and the same lesson’s starter code with live result on Side B. The three actual HTML lessons appear as an ordered track list with no runtime claims. Flip/selection switches content in place; all controls remain labeled.
options.case: The fold maps cleanly to explanation and practice, and the ordered tracks make a short beginner course feel complete.
options.risk: The cassette metaphor can become nostalgia without functional fold and course-sequence behavior.

options.label: Learning Departure Board
options.lineage: Pocket timetables and raked racks of station-information slides
options.thesis: Make the available learning routes and the current place in a course visible at one glance.
options.viewport: A compact route board lists HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python with their real lesson counts; selecting HTML reveals “Pengenalan HTML”, its explanation and code preview in an opaque ivory pane. A thin station marker shows the current lesson position. Type hierarchy uses weight, case and rules, not motion or color alone.
options.case: The route and stop vocabulary makes ordered course contents exceptionally scannable.
options.risk: Angled slides and constrained type can reduce readability; the lesson prose must stay upright, opaque and comfortably sized.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clear learning SaaS with a course catalog, a focused lesson view and an accessible live editor.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar navigation bar, plain-language “Belajar coding dari dasar” introduction, real course counts, and lesson pages with content beside code and preview.
canonCard.risk: Efficient and recognizable, but intentionally familiar to the category.
